edge_explainer: Cause: Q2'26 (07-30) beat revenue, profit AND guidance but US daily uniques went sequentially negative for the first time and management called Google search referrals 'choppy' -> -21.0% on 07-31 (178.04->140.67), +10.3% rebound to 155.20 on 08-03. Estimate axis is a textbook DE-RATE (FY26e EPS +8.0%, FY27e +9.3% over 90 days, revised UP again after the crash) while the multiple compressed 45%. Engagement axis is a DERAILMENT RISK: estimates are revised off reported revenue and lag the user input by 1-2 quarters, so 'estimates rising' is lagging confirmation and the bear metric is leading. Management DISCLOSED the DAU decline - the 21% discount is informed, not opaque, which removes the usual mispricing edge. Cap structure pulled first: 192.41M shares all-classes (not the 142.0M Class-A figure in the quote feed), $2.77B net cash, EV $27.1B = 6.1x FY27e EV/S, 22.4x FY27e P/E, GAAP op margin 28.8% already after 12.5%-of-revenue SBC. AI-complex: two-sided and roughly self-hedging against the frozen AI-BREAK 0.45 call - the ~5% data-licensing leg needs the cycle, but AI-search is what is breaking the referral funnel, so a cycle break relieves the pressure that caused the drawdown. Entry does NOT require the cycle holding. Top unverifiable: the logged-in vs logged-out DAU decomposition - if only search-referred users fell, the ARPU-weighted base improved and the -21% was a headline artifact.
